title: Exact-functor transport on resolution cocycles
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with Ext, and let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be additive and preserve finite limits and colimits. Let $R$ be an injective resolution of $A\in\mathcal C$ and $I$ an injective resolution of $B\in\mathcal D$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For a morphism $f:LA\to B$, let $e:LR^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ be a cochain map satisfying $L(\iota_R^0)e^0=f\iota_I^0$. Let $P\in\mathcal C$, $q\ge0$, and $a:P\to R^q$ with $ad_R^q=0$. Write $h_c$ for any proof that $L(a)e^q d_I^q=0$. Then $L_{\mathrm{Ext}}(\operatorname{extMk}_R(a))\circ\mathrm{Ext}^0(f)=\operatorname{extMk}_I(L(a)e^q)$ in $\mathrm{Ext}^q(LP,B)$. The statement makes no assumption that $L$ preserves injectives; it only uses the supplied comparison $e$.

proof.text: Extend R, I and e by zero to integer-indexed complexes. Construct the natural isomorphism between extending LR and applying L to the extension of R termwise: in nonnegative degree it is the identity through the extension component isomorphisms; in negative degree both objects are zero. Use the augmentation equality to show that the extended e composed with the mapped augmentation equals the single-complex map of f followed by the augmentation of I.

Exactness of L preserves the augmentation quasi-isomorphism. Apply the derived-category localization and invert the augmentations in the preceding square. This identifies the resulting coefficient map with f, independently of any preservation of injectives by L.

The formula Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extMk_hom expresses the cocycle class as the localized shifted map from a single complex followed by the inverse augmentation. The formula Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom transports this expression through L. Naturality of the single-complex and shift isomorphisms, followed by the localized augmentation square, gives the class of L(a)e^q. Its closedness is hc. There are no negative boundaries in degree zero; zero objects satisfy the same computation.

lean.statement:
theorem exactFunctor_resolution_cocycle
    {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasExt.{w₁} C] [HasExt.{w₂} D]
    (L : C ⥤ D) [L.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L]
    {A : C} {B : D} (f : L.obj A ⟶ B)
    (R : InjectiveResolution A) (I : InjectiveResolution B)
    (e : (L.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj R.cocomplex ⟶ I.cocomplex)
    (he : L.map (R.ι.f 0) ≫ e.f 0 = f ≫ I.ι.f 0)
    {P : C} (q : ℕ) (a : P ⟶ R.cocomplex.X q)
    (ha : a ≫ R.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
    (hc : (L.map a ≫ e.f q) ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0) :
    ((R.extMk a (q + 1) rfl ha).mapExactFunctor L).comp
      (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f) (add_zero q) = I.extMk (L.map a ≫ e.f q) (q + 1) rfl hc
